title: CubeOS HAL — privileged Hardware Abstraction Layer

parent_project.note: This is the privileged HAL component. CubeOS project Article I (HAL Owns the Host) is the foundational invariant for this repo's existence.

_bounded_contexts_note: config + devices + middleware are real packages under internal/. The rest (system through hardware) are functional contexts within internal/handlers/ which is one Go package containing ~47 files grouped by domain (one file per /<context>/ route prefix in routes.go).
release_workflow: push-to-main-deploys-automatically (CI auto-deploys to all registered Pi devices)

parallel_dev_exception.workflow: merge/<feature_id> short-lived branch + 1 MR per feature + auto-delete branch on merge
parallel_dev_exception.rationale: Per CubeOS project-level ADR-0008. HAL changes carry higher risk (privileged container); operator-gated MR review.

security_posture: privileged container; host network mode; X-HAL-Key + role-based ACL on every endpoint except /health and /docs
container_pattern: privileged + host network; X-HAL-Key on every endpoint; role-based per-prefix ACL (core/meshsat/readonly); CUBEOS_TIER full/container gating for destructive endpoints
hardware_categories_real: RTC (under system.go or dedicated handler — /rtc routes incl. wakealarm)
Network (network.go + network_capabilities.go + network_ports.go + network_wifi_saved.go + network_wifi_status.go + wifi_ap.go)
_surfaces_note: http_api=true (the REST API IS the product). events=true because /meshtastic/events + /iridium/events are SSE streams. persistent_data=true because of /cubeos/config/wifi-ap-{whitelist,blacklist}.json + saved WiFi network config + UPS configuration.
